title: Jonah and the Signal
author: Mara Delacroix
blurb: Jonah Eastwick, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
